$comment: Lane profiles (architecture.md section 6). Two profiles, two gate sets; profile selects the gate set id. Cap-and-flag iteration policy: a lane auto-iterates up to iteration_cap gate-fail-fix cycles per beat, then STOPS and flags the user with failure evidence and disclosed remedies (remedies are proposals; only the user or leader loosens a gate).

fast-demo.description: Default. Cheap gates, minutes turnaround, for guidance/demo cuts the user iterates on fast.

film+goldens.description: Strict. Customer-facing cuts. Everything in fast-demo plus determinism CI, goldens, 3-launch re-capture, film tolerances.

comparison_thresholds_default._note: PROPOSED INITIAL VALUES / calibration seeds — superseded by derived thresholds at mint (calibration: mean - k*sigma, k=3, min 5 samples). Uncalibrated fallback (fail-closed) = ssim_min 0.995 / dhash_hamming_max 2.
